section
Sinking vs. Sourcing

**Sinking Input Module** (most common in North America):
- Module provides the path to ground (0V)
- Field device provides the positive (+) voltage
- PNP (sourcing) sensors connect directly

**Sourcing Input Module:**
- Module provides the positive (+) voltage
- Field device switches the path to ground
- NPN (sinking) sensors connect directly

> **Rule of Thumb:** In North America, most systems use **sinking input modules** with **PNP (sourcing) sensors**. In Europe/Asia, s
